C1528.title: Police in Putian Recover Over 350,000 Yuan in Two Fraud Cases
C1528.summary: In November 2025, a resident surnamed Cai in Xianyou County, Putian, met a stranger on Telegram who promoted a high-yield fund investment and induced Cai to transfer RMB 300,000 to a designated account before disappearing. After Cai reported the fraud to the Linan Police Station of the Xianyou County Public Security Bureau, officers traced the funds and initiated emergency payment suspension to intercept the money and prevent further loss.
